fields.statement: Verified internal/textref at 6d9b05e3 (attempt 2). go test -count=1 ./internal/textref passes; FuzzRoundTrip and FuzzStoredRoundTrip each ran 30s clean. TestFind/TestResolve/TestFormat cover every acceptance point, and a scratch probe (removed) confirmed: references start at text start, after whitespace, ( or [; handles, IDs and 4+ char prefixes (@01M is none); darin@hey.com, checkout@v7, '@key' hold none; @@ resolves to a literal @; Resolve rewrites @alpha, @01M6HP0C and @{01M6HP0C} to @{<full ID>} and returns @{BOGUS} and @01M6 unresolved with offsets; Format shows a live stored ref as @alpha, a retired or unknown full ID as @{<full ID>}, and stored @{ID}, @{BOGUS} and @{<full ID>} as @@{ID}, @@{BOGUS}, @@{<full ID>} (attempt 1's finding f1 is fixed and covered in TestFormat), and @word as @@word. fmt-check and vet pass. make check's other failures do not come from this leaf: a stale render of the builder's committed actor record, and the TestReadBudget/TestBudget timing budgets in internal/api and internal/slice at load average 8-11. Nothing imports textref, and the leaf only adds that package.
